scripts.dev: npm run build -w @webworld/shared && concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @webworld/server" "npm run dev -w @webworld/client"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @webworld/shared && npm run dev -w @webworld/server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build -w @webworld/shared && npm run dev -w @webworld/client
scripts.build: npm run build -w @webworld/shared && npm run build -w @webworld/server && npm run build -w @webworld/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @webworld/shared && npm run typecheck -w @webworld/server && npm run typecheck -w @webworld/client
